theorems.name: Submission.cmr_vr_coordinate_assembly
theorems.statement: ∀ (X : Type) [TopologicalSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X] [OpensMeasurableSpace X] (d : ℕ) (L : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap X (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (μ₀ : Measure X) (ρ : Fin d → X → ℝ), (∀ i, Measurable (ρ i)) → (∀ i, ∀ K : Set X, IsCompact K → IntegrableOn (ρ i) K μ₀) → (∀ (i : Fin d) (f : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap X ℝ) (g : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap X (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))), (∀ x, g x = f x • EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) → L g = ∫ x, f x * ρ i x ∂μ₀) → ∃ ν : X → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d), Measurable ν ∧ (∀ K : Set X, IsCompact K → IntegrableOn ν K μ₀) ∧ ∀ g : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap X (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)), L g = ∫ x, inner ℝ (g x) (ν x) ∂μ₀
